UI_options_ZomboLust_difficulty_tooltip:
Determines how fast animations unlock based on your survival time and the intensity of penalties upon mini-game failure.
- Casual: Everything unlocked from start. No penalties.
- Normal: Standard progression (1 month / 2 months). Moderate penalties (2-5%% HP, 1 scratch).
- Vicious: Slow progression (2 months / 4 months). Severe penalties (5-10%% HP, 1-2 scratches).
UI_options_ZomboLust_invertMinigame: Passive Mini-Game (stay still to lose on purpose)
UI_options_ZomboLust_invertMinigame_tool:
Changes what counts as "winning" the mini-game.
- Enabled (default): Doing nothing until the timer runs out lets the scene continue.
 Pressing SPACE while the cursor is in the pink zone lets you escape unharmed.

- Disabled: You control the zombie and must stop the cursor in the pink zone to let the scene continue.
UI_options_ZomboLust_biteChance_tooltip:
Chance (0-100%%) that a zombie has of biting you instead of triggering the sexual animation, once it reaches you and you have no clothing left to remove.
- 0%%: The sexual animation always triggers; zombies never bite once you are fully undressed.
- 100%%: Zombies always bite; the sexual animation never triggers.
Default: 35%%.
UI_options_ZomboLust_zoom_enabled_toolti:
Replaces the vanilla camera zoom range with the settings below. Off by default: the base game's zoom is left untouched unless you opt in.
Press Apply after changing any value.
UI_options_ZomboLust_zoom_min_tooltip:
Closest (most zoomed-in) camera limit, as a percentage of the default game zoom. Lower values allow tighter close-ups.
Press Apply after changing any value.
UI_options_ZomboLust_zoom_max_tooltip:
Farthest (most zoomed-out) camera limit, as a percentage of the default game zoom.
Press Apply after changing any value.
UI_options_ZomboLust_zoom_steps_tooltip:
Number of zoom stops generated between the closest and farthest limits.
Stops follow a logarithmic scale: closely spaced near the closest limit for fine control, more widely spaced near the farthest limit for faster scrolling.
Press Apply after changing any value.
